muerta.desc:
Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.

Damage: 225/300/375/450

Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing 225 damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for 3s — rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed by 30% and takes 20% more magic damage.

Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.

Damage: 225/300/375/450
